summary: Deepgram acquired OfOne, an AI-native voice ordering platform built for QSR drive-thrus, announced alongside a $130 million Series C funding round at a $1.3 billion valuation (January 13, 2026). The OfOne technology now anchors "Deepgram for Restaurants."
Deepgram's Series C valued the company at $1.3 billion, raising total funding to power its voice-AI platform across sectors including restaurants.

Deepgram for Restaurants offers voice AI across drive-thru, phone, and kiosk order channels, positioning Deepgram as an AI voice-ordering layer that can sit alongside or compete with a POS vendor's own drive-thru/voice-ordering module.

OfOne's pre-acquisition drive-thru voice AI reported more than 95% order containment for "national QSR brands," per Deepgram's own materials. (Scope note: Specific restaurant brand names are not disclosed; containment figure is vendor-reported, pre-acquisition.)
